authority: 2026-09-10 owner requested extending the plan beyond the retained 153 beams to other models and foreseeable issues.
objective: Extend the maintained ETABS workflow with source-backed model coverage, bounded implementation packets, independent qualification and future-issue triage.

bounded_units.outcome: Reconcile observed baseline restrictions with existing source, topology, engineering, application and delivery requirements.
Define coverage cases, packet ownership, model-corpus rules, truthful completion states and recurrence admission in the existing plan.
Align current entry points and session records, then verify and deliver one documentation candidate.

acceptance_rows.outcome: Every BC-01 through BC-20 row declares model variation or issue, observed-versus-prospective evidence, responsible packet and measurable required outcome.
C0a, C0b and C0c specify concrete source, result-state and action/topology/method deliverables, with compatible legacy behavior and no fabricated actions or inputs.

Independent models, strata, locked holdouts, per-model denominators and exact supported/unsupported/missing-input outcomes prevent a small fixture or excluded members from establishing broad qualification.
Core evaluation, engineering verdict, full design, solver comparison and source freshness remain distinct; later search/copy/automation/output gates consume explicit qualified profiles.
Foreseeable seismic, nonrectangular, special-beam, runtime, scaling, stale-data and recovery conditions have explicit admission or deferral rules without claiming new implemented support.
Future failures enter a reproducible, root-cause-bound coverage record and affected requalification; held or failed model cases cannot be silently removed from the cohort.
README, current plan, WP10 next packet, task board and next-session briefing route to the same updated plan and preserve historical acceptance evidence.

non_goals: No runtime code, test, formula, source model, installed application, worksheet or package change.
No new live API qualification, engineering completion or universal model-support claim.
No activation of column, slab, wall, foundation or special-system design; their beam context may be planned.
No changed historical WP11 acceptance, original phase numbering or project-end PF9 timing/memory targets.
No cleanup of preserved user edits, old worktrees or branches; no release or publication of software packages.
likely_pitfalls: Treating an API method inventory, a green fixture or accounted Unsupported members as broad usable design.
Silently zeroing axial/minor-axis/torsional actions, inventing SLS or admitting all geometry by removing guards.
Using the same model with synthetic variations as independent building evidence or tuning against holdouts.
Duplicating plan ownership, counting future scenarios as observed defects or weakening full-design qualification.

verification.runtime_tests: None: planning-only changes do not alter runtime behavior.
verification.delivery: One frozen documentation candidate, separate read-only acceptance pass, candidate integrity and required hosted PR checks.
